derivedParts.label: UNKNOWN
derivedParts.notes: Only an enclosure-space placeholder, no inferred component placement; excluded from accuracy certification.
Independent printed-paper plane estimated from this SKU photo and native CAD bounds, +/-0.5mm placement uncertainty; shell/hardware pixels excluded. Not a populated PCB substitute.

limitations: Handset and dock are separate products in the kit; the CAD dock includes stand geometry beyond the 84×54×8 mm handset. No dock dimensions pass is asserted.
Dock latch component identity is unlabelled in STL; retained source positions are not an electrical or assembly-service claim.
Digital EPD/touch/wake runtime is partial and documented separately; geometry preview does not establish whole firmware or dock compatibility.
Photo and geometry comparisons remain partial; no complete 1:1 manufacturing or populated-PCB certification.
Source CAD MIT and manufacturer photographs have distinct rights; no separate open photo license verified.
Blank display rectangle uses documented active dimensions when available; placement/window boundary is estimated from photos/CAD, not a calibrated measurement.
本轮继续按真实厂家照片审核；刻字、部分贴纸、端子及内部PCB未全部还原，不能视为整机1:1通过。

Default scene retains native handset and dock cluster;54x84x8mm belongs to handset only, complete dock assembly envelope not certified by that size. Dock geometry is not scaled into handset dimensions.

The existing native actuator face is selected by explicit original source-face ranges. The ordered original vertex/normal binary is unchanged; unmapped adjacent shell and reset areas remain ordinary occluders.
